entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-27
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • Strict ordering of DbParameter on DbCommand #38273
  • Support evaluating `Expression<T>` inside a lambda expression #38316
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: Support byte[] / ReadOnlySpan<byte> for encryption key to enable secure memory handling #38097
  • Recommended approach for joining a query with an in-memory collection of complex objects #38319
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: Support BigInteger, Int128 & UInt128 #30930
  • What is the intended behaviour when a transient and an intransient SQL Server error code appear together? #38320
  • DbContextPool not decrementing active_dbcontexts metrics #38306

Updated

  • NativeAOT Unable to create a 'DbContext' of type 'AnalystDbContext'. The exception 'The type initializer for '<Module>' threw an exception.' was thrown while attempting to create an instance. For the different patterns supported at design time... #38317

  • Make it easy to use methods that return Expression<TDelegate> in LINQ queries #10497

    Backlog

    Backlog
